name: item_move_whole_set
description: Frozen reference behaviour: an item-mode translate moves the WHOLE selected set, not just the distinguished item. Three items are selected and given a single translate of -1.2 on Y; all three land -1.2 lower and none of them moves on X. Companion to item_acen_primary_of_three: the shared centre follows the primary alone, but the motion applies to every selected item — the two are deliberately NOT the same set.
source: Frozen reference capture (headless, scripted): a numeric translate attribute followed by an apply, read back as per-item positions. Two different transform configurations produced identical results.

provenance.harness: private headless capture harness (scripts + per-case result JSON live in the private tree)
provenance.notes: Driven as a numeric attribute + apply rather than a viewport drag, so the amount is exact rather than pixel-derived. The X column is asserted UNCHANGED as well as the Y column moved: a implementation that moved the set along the wrong axis, or that rebased every item onto the shared centre, would disturb X.

rig.comment: Identical rig to item_acen_primary_of_three — same three items, same selection order, so the two fixtures pin the centre and the moving set on ONE state.

expected.law: every selected item translates by the same world delta; the distinguished item is not privileged in the motion

rejected.candidate: the set collapses onto the shared centre

classification.detail: vibe3d binds the item transform to the whole selected item set and translates each about the shared frozen centre; the measured after-positions are identical to the reference's, including the untouched X column. This fixture is a LIVE test that must pass.
